findings.text: Wolf Creek master authority: under the 2002 Master Declaration, Declarant (Wolf Creek Properties, LC) had sole architectural jurisdiction until delegation or termination. On termination, the Association acting through the DRB assumes jurisdiction. A March 2013 instrument terminates that master Declarant's rights, including Article IV, and ends Class B status. It leaves the other Declaration terms in force. That termination is not carried over to Eden Village or the Trappers Ridge Declaration.
